title: Keep include! fragments rustfmt-clean with a maintained check
outcome: Follow-up from tm-56c0 (Greg has not yet decided; filed so the question is not lost). cargo fmt only follows mod declarations, so cargo fmt -- --check never covers the 132 include!() fragments under src/ (or their #[path] test children); after 72df019 and 47a061e they are all rustfmt --edition 2024 clean, but drift can return silently. Options: (a) a small script (e.g. scripts/fmt-fragments.mjs or a shell wrapper) that runs rustfmt --check --edition 2024 over every include! target and exits non-zero on any Diff, wired as a launcher stage or documented as a pre-commit step; (b) leave it manual. Decide with Greg before implementing; the launcher must not gain a stage without his approval.
